A mobile game shows a progression gate (a forced pause) at an early level. An A/B test moves that gate to a later level. Intuitively, a later gate gives players more runway and more rounds before they hit the pause, which should help them come back. But pushing the gate later could also change pacing in ways that reduce the habit-forming early hook. Will 7-day retention go UP or DOWN when the gate is moved later?

A streaming app ships a new feature to a random half of users. It plausibly helps lighter, more casual users by making it easier to find something to watch, but it may hurt heavier users by cluttering a flow they already had mastered. The population is a mix of light and heavy users. Will the overall average engagement outcome go UP or DOWN across the whole user base?
